svg.text: WHAT HAPPENS TO AN AGENT'S TOOL CALL
Solid: today, for claude, cursor and pi (codex runs without guards, #21). Dashed green: the target.
02/04 The hook asks the shared rules.
03/04 A template with no values: allowed.
04/05 The trace is kept, the agent is told why.
05/05 It carries on without the secret.
SCENARIO 3/3 · TARGET: A RULE MISSES A TRICK
01/06 A script written to get around the text rules.
03/06 The text rules do not recognise it: allowed.
04/06 It starts, but inside the OS sandbox.
05/06 The OS denies what the rules missed.
06/06 Refused below the rules, and traced.
